A vast crypt of opened stone tombs receding into darkness, lids cast aside, bone-dust drifting in shafts of sickly green light, the far vaults lost in shadow.
A blighted battlefield of the unburied dead under a swollen blood-moon, broken banners and bones half-sunk in black mud stretching to a smoking horizon.
A black necropolis of jagged bone-towers clawing at a starless sky, narrow streets choked with fog, faint green fires flickering in the windows.
A ritual chamber carved with ten thousand skulls, a black altar slicked with old blood at its center, pale candlelight guttering in a wind from nowhere.
A fog-drowned graveyard of crooked headstones swallowed to their shoulders in white mist, iron gates twisted open, the distant tree-line lost entirely in grey silence.
A ruined cathedral claimed by the dead, its vaulted roof collapsed to open sky, bone-white weeds splitting the flagstones, skeletal figures kneeling in rusted pews.
A swamp of sunken corpses half-swallowed in black water, pale hands rising from the surface, dead cypress draped in grey moss, a faint phosphorescent glow below.
A throne-hall of bones, walls built from stacked skulls and femurs floor to ceiling, a great chair of fused skeletons on a dais, torchlight throwing long shadows.
A cursed catacomb of endless branching passages, the niches overflowing with crumbling dead, strange sigils burned into the stone walls, a distant chanting with no discernible source.
An ash-wasteland of impaled banners, scorched earth stretching flat to a red horizon, armored corpses pinned to stakes in neat rows, cinders drifting like black snow.
A haunted moor under a sickly yellow sky, treacherous black pools reflecting no light, the bleached skulls of livestock marking a half-vanished path, fog clinging at the knees.
A tomb-pyramid interior of descending shafts and tight passages, hieroglyphs of resurrection carved floor to ceiling, black oil burning in stone sconces, the air thick with decay.
A flooded ossuary, ankle-deep black water reflecting a low ceiling strung with hanging bones, the far archways sunken to their keystones, something moving unseen beneath the surface.
A ravine of mass graves collapsed open, the layered dead exposed in pale strata along the walls, crows roosting in absolute silence on the rim above.
A frozen tundra of half-emerged corpses locked in ice, their faces pressed upward against a glass ceiling of frost, a pale aurora writhing overhead in sick green.
A grand library of the dead, shelves of bones catalogued and labelled in forgotten script, reading desks occupied by seated skeletons, a single black candle burning at the far end.
A collapsed mine shaft reopened by necrotic force, the timbers rotted to black stumps, the dead crouching in the hewn walls, a deep green luminescence rising from below.
A sunken city visible through cracked earth, its towers intact beneath the surface, the streets populated with standing corpses frozen mid-motion, roots threading through every open mouth.
A gallows-field of iron gibbets stretching across a dead plain, each cage occupied, the chains groaning in no wind, a bone-pale moon hanging directly overhead without setting.
A poisoned river valley where nothing rots, the ancient dead preserved in grey skin along both banks, black water flowing without sound between them toward a lightless gulf.
A siege-broken fortress interior, the courtyard heaped with the defenders still in formation, a green fire burning in the ruined keep, the portcullis raised by unseen hands.
A monastic ruin where the monks were buried standing in the walls, their faces emerging from the stone mid-chest, mouths open, the cloister garden entirely black and leafless.
A mountain pass of avalanche-dead, thousands preserved in the rockfall for centuries, now half-thawed and stirring, the narrow trail winding between pale reaching arms on either side.
A volcanic caldera of hardened black rock studded with bones fused into the basalt, red light seeping from deep fissures below, the crater rim ringed with watching silhouettes.
A great ossuary amphitheater open to a starless sky, tiered seats of packed bone rising around a sunken stage, green magefire illuminating an empty lectern at the center.
